report.summary: Chunk 1 of 7 of daedalus/spine/docrefs.py: module docstring, imports, constants, and regex patterns. No exports or logic yet.

handoff.purpose: Module docstring explaining problem, false-positive filter, anti-gaming property, and invariants; imports; constant DOC_GLOBS; regex patterns for inline code, fences, list markers, placeholders.

symbols.name: DOC_GLOBS
symbols.note: Tuple of glob patterns for documentation files: docs/**/*.md and README.md.

symbols.name: _INLINE_CODE
symbols.note: Regex to match single-backtick inline code spans, excluding newlines.

symbols.name: _FENCE
symbols.note: Regex to match fenced code block openers/closers (``` or ~~~).

symbols.name: _LIST_MARKER
symbols.note: Regex to match list markers (-, *, +, numbered, or >).

claims.text: A fence opener/closer in markdown.

claims.text: A list marker, so an indented list continuation is not mistaken for an indented code block.
